tasks.label: 📊 Scan Source Code Files
args: Write-Host 'Scanning Source Code directory...' -ForegroundColor Blue; (Get-ChildItem 'Source Code' -Recurse -File | Measure-Object).Count

tasks.label: 🔍 Find Component Files
args: $componentName = Read-Host 'Enter component name'; Write-Host "Searching for $componentName files..." -ForegroundColor Green; Get-ChildItem 'Source Code' -Recurse -File | Select-String -Pattern $componentName | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Path | Sort-Object -Unique

tasks.label: ✅ Validate Component Documentation
args: $component = Read-Host 'Enter component folder name'; $files = @('01_SPECIFICATION.md', '02_UI_MOCKUP.md', '03_TECHNICAL_ANALYSIS.md', '04_BUSINESS_LOGIC.md', '05_CODE_ARTIFACTS.md', 'README.md', 'VALIDATION_REPORT.md'); $missing = @(); foreach ($file in $files) { if (-not (Test-Path "$component\$file")) { $missing += $file } }; if ($missing.Count -eq 0) { Write-Host '✅ All 7 files present!' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host "❌ Missing: $($missing -join ', ')" -ForegroundColor Red }
